author: Top Gear
description:
It’s a long time since Cadillac built a luxury car that could challenge the world’s best, but in the Celestiq it has such a vehicle. Can it go toe-to-toe with the Rolls-Royce Spectre Black Badge, the British brand’s upgraded super-coupe? We put the electric pair head-to-head in the Caddy’s hometown of Detroit to find out…

🚗 Cadillac Celestiq & Rolls-Royce Spectre
